title: Glass Footwork Furnace
prompt: drum n bass meets aphex twin with ambient intros
description: A shimmering beatless wash blooms before a CasioRZ1 kit ignites into footwork rolls and jungle ratchets over a rolling sine sub. The track peaks early in a bitcrushed percussion storm, then deconstructs itself into ratcheting fragments and a dry ambient fade.
